args.actions: 1) Watched status and logs, then read the BlockLog CSV and found TNT_Tommy breaking blocks one by one. 2) Declared the incident. 3) Switched TNT_Tommy to adventure mode to stop the breaking right away. 4) Banned TNT_Tommy, which kicked him; a reconnect attempt at 07:31:07 was refused. 5) Restored the wall with `fill 14 -60 8 14 -56 14 oak_planks replace air`, which filled 35 blocks. 6) Ran `fill 14 -58 10 14 -58 12 glass_pane replace oak_planks`, which put back the 3 glass panes. 7) Checked the result with execute if block/blocks (all tests passed) and kept watching: no more breaks, TPS 20.
args.residual_risk: The server runs in offline mode (online-mode=false), so a banned player can come back under a different username. Glass panes were placed with default block states; pane connections update with neighbors, but other block states (such as plank orientation) may differ slightly from the original. Items the griefer may have picked up were not dealt with. Build ownership in protected.json was not confirmed because the file was too large to read with the tools I had.
